permission.description: Permission object: host group or template group permission to assign to the user group.

id.description: ID of the host group or template group to add permission to. Property behavior: required.

permission.description: Access level to the host group or template group. Possible values: 0 - access denied; 2 - read-only access; 3 - read-write access.

groupid.description: ID of the host group to add permission to. Property behavior: required.

userRef.description: User to assign to the user group. The user must have only the userid property defined.

usrgrpid.description: ID of the user group. Property behavior: read-only; required for update operations.

debug_mode.description: Whether debug mode is enabled or disabled. Possible values: 0 - (default) disabled; 1 - enabled.

gui_access.description: Frontend authentication method of the users in the group. Possible values: 0 - (default) use the system default authentication method; 1 - use internal authentication; 2 - use LDAP authentication; 3 - disable access to the frontend.

mfa_status.description: Whether MFA is enabled or disabled for the users in the group. Possible values: 0 - disabled (for all configured MFA methods); 1 - enabled (for all configured MFA methods).

mfaid.description: MFA method used for the users in the group. Property behavior: supported for Super admin type users (since Zabbix 7.0.9); supported if mfa_status of Authentication object is set to "Enabled".

users_status.description: Whether the user group is enabled or disabled. For deprovisioned users, the user group cannot be enabled. Possible values: 0 - (default) enabled; 1 - disabled.

userdirectoryid.description: ID of the user directory used for authentication. Property behavior: supported for Super admin type users (since Zabbix 7.0.9); supported if gui_access is set to "use the system default authentication method" or "use LDAP authentication".

hostgroup_rights.description: Host group permissions to replace the current permissions assigned to the user group.

templategroup_rights.description: Template group permissions to replace the current permissions assigned to the user group.

tag_filters.description: Tag-based permissions to replace the current permissions assigned to the user group.

users.description: Users to replace the current users assigned to the user group. The user must have only the userid property defined.

rights.description: Deprecated, please use hostgroup_rights or templategroup_rights instead. Permissions to assign to the user group.
